duplicatedPatterns.detail: CareSection and inherited BatteryCareSection both implement loading/error/empty card shells. This is an existing migration bridge, not grounds to delete specialist content or build a third shell.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Retain both until exact specialist header, notice, placement and state parity is established; reuse LayoutCard and existing feedback rather than introducing another composite.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Same source warnings can recur in summary, risk, individual evidence, trend and both specialists. Source ownership is valuable, but degraded mode could have substantial repeated notice height.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Evaluate real partial/offline view before consolidating; keep per-source identity and retry reachable and do not suppress a warning for a section that depends on it.

sourceConfirmed: PageLayout has w-full/min-w-0 and @container; CardGrid measures allocated width and delegates packing rather than duplicating viewport layout.
Risk and SoC evidence use container-dependent inner columns with min-w-0; energy uses @lg:grid-cols-2.
Monthly chart uses ResponsiveContainer, fixed 340px height and compact dual axes; real DataTable has mobile card roles for all four columns.
Inherited methodology uses viewport sm:grid-cols-4 inside a half-card, not measured-card width.

issues.detail: Four-column methodology tiles activate at viewport sm even if CardGrid allocates a narrow half-card; the two-column minimum may also be tight at 320px with long translated labels.
issues.fix: Use inherited container-aware layout strategy without removing the four counts or explanations; verify 320px and narrow desktop card allocations with long labels.

issues.detail: Known EvidenceBar values inherit a nowrap flex header with label and sublabel, while unknown rows wrap independently. Long SoC labels plus percentage/count text may overflow narrow cards; no rendered overflow observed.
issues.fix: Exercise narrow known-value tracks first; if confirmed, shared MetricBar owner should support wrapping headers or constrain text without hiding evidence.

responsive.verification: All ten required widths, allocated-container geometry, RTL, text zoom and real mobile scroll behavior unverified.

sourceConfirmed: Titles and sections carry translated labels; decorative icons have aria-hidden.
MetricBar has labelled progressbar range/value semantics; missing values use explicit visible dash.
Monthly chart provides ariaLabel and dataColumns plus an additive real captioned DataTable, so meaning need not rely solely on plot colors.
LayoutCard descriptions have existing Tooltip/Button keyboard composition; OperationalBrief review is an actual shared Button/Drawer path.
FadeIn and MetricBar call existing motion-preference hook, preserving OS/low-bandwidth policy.
acceptanceRequired: Keyboard/focus/escape/return focus for description help, Review details drawer, chart export and legend interactions.
Screen-reader behavior of nested summary regions, progressbar percentage versus point deductions, table cards and partial-source notices.
Composed text/UI contrast, light/dark/custom themes, forced colors and 44px touch reachability.
accessibility.verification: Source semantics only; no browser, screen reader, contrast measurement or keyboard session performed.

states.loading: Query payload absent leads to contextual skeletons while titles remain mounted; CareSection.tsx:35-48, CareMonthlyTrend.tsx:88,107.
states.empty: Resolved empty arrays count as received payload; eligibility guards choose section-specific EmptyState; no fake zero care index.
states.error: Initial fatal failures replace only dependent body; retries route through existing source refetch. Mixed outcomes retain independent content via state.ts:15-44.
states.stale: Retained data stays in computeBatteryCare and notices; BatteryEvidenceBrief status has retained flag based on source status=stale.
states.offline: CareSourceNotices exposes paused-source unavailable message. Absent-payload skeletons still render beneath the notice.
states.partial: Composite hasData is any received payload; combined partial state retains available observations; per-source fatal/paused/partial notices remain.
states.success: Only calibrated score/components and eligible evidence appear; null score/unknown shares are not fabricated measurements.
states.disabled: No selected vehicle disables both query hooks and renders governed onboarding recovery. Exportability is explicitly disabled during loading, fatal error or no monthly observations.

issues.detail: Absent payload always selects Skeleton unless composite fatalError exists, including paused offline sources. Specialist state and monthly chart follow the same rule. A paused first fetch can therefore display indefinite loading geometry alongside a correct offline notice.
issues.fix: Distinguish initial actively pending from initial paused/unavailable in the feature presentation adapter while retaining source notice and recovery, titles and all section shells.

issues.detail: When no payload exists, one source fails and the other is pending/paused, combineDataStates supplies no aggregate fatalError; per-source QueryError also requires trust.hasData. Combined sections temporarily omit the failed source's retry, although its single-source section can expose it.
issues.fix: Surface per-source initial failure and retry independent of aggregate hasData; avoid converting mixed pending/failure into whole-page failure.

visualIssues.detail: Known risk, energy and SoC bars use arbitrary-index saturated series colors and inherit MetricBar's default gradient. Multiple non-time-series histograms can spend visual emphasis on decoration rather than risk meaning.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing fill=solid and restrained canonical semantic/neutral colors for evidence tracks after preserving bin identity, ordering, labels and counts; retain saved user chart palette choices.

visualIssues.detail: Three informational rows use fixed cyan, amber and indigo icon hues and a purple title icon despite being methodology rather than separate severity states. This is saturation noise, not proof of neon or contrast failure.
visualIssues.fix: Use theme-aware muted/secondary decorative icon tokens; retain every explanation and actual semantic warning badge.

architectureIssues.detail: Feature imports LayoutCard via layout-reference despite current layout category barrel exporting it. CareSummary likewise imports StatMetric via stat-reference though the data-display barrel exports it. SpecialistSlot's placement hook is not exported in the inspected layout barrel.
architectureIssues.fix: Use existing category exports for LayoutCard and StatMetric; coordinate a placement-hook export with the shared layout owner rather than duplicating grid placement.

architectureIssues.detail: Model alias documentation describes hexagonal /charging-sessions while this mounted page's hook reads /charging. Documentation must not be treated as evidence that the actual endpoint emits those aliases.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep existing SI-equivalent alias support; align comment with verified source ownership during a separately authorized implementation review, without changing hook endpoint/cache/model inputs based on this audit.

priority.rationale: Already source-migrated to PageLayout/CardGrid, OperationalBrief, data trust, display-only SI formatting and real mobile evidence table. Preserve these; address bounded presentation/state residuals rather than rebuild.
